purpose: Requirements for the forge review policy: document-driven review limited to rule conformance, contradiction and needless complexity, with targeting, intervention, backend and verification axes.
summary: Background: over-proposal and double detection in AI review; shift to document-centric review with review results treated as observations, not instructions
Three review priorities P1 rule conformance, P2 contradiction, P3 needless complexity; criteria hold no perspective or judgment and use a fixed three-section structure
Target axes --diff, --branch, --files, --dirs are mutually exclusive, and the target granularity the user specified is preserved when passed to the reviewer
Intervention axes --interactive and --auto, where automatic fixing depends on the main agent confidence (fix confidence versus finding confidence), not severity
Optional axes: focus (points of attention), scope (completion baseline), and carrying in project rules and specs
Backend axis: resolution order, fail-closed behavior, availability check, retains_context declaration, finding locations, and failure and cleanup handling
Quality assurance: chain-of-verification self-check of findings and independent evaluator assessment with mechanical linkage of all findings
Permanent document-reference review viewpoint, built-in anti-pattern fallback rules, and issue creation under three conditions when rules are missing
CLI structure designed to avoid AI misjudgment, principles expansion with severity catalog, affected targets, and open TBD items
tasks: Writing or revising the review skill and its SKILL.md
Designing review backends, reviewer and evaluator definitions
Authoring review_criteria files and review priorities specs
Reviewing requirement, design and plan documents
Implementing review request building and target resolution scripts
Deciding auto-fix versus interactive handling of review findings
Handling missing-rule discoveries and issue creation from review
title: REQ-013 レビューポリシー要件
